description: Implementation of the QuicheIpAddress class and related IP address handling functions, including address creation, comparison, string conversion, and subnet operations.

classes.name: QuicheIpAddress
classes.description: Represents an IP address supporting IPv4 and IPv6, with methods for address creation, comparison, string conversion, and subnet operations.

classes.name: QuicheIpPrefix
classes.description: Represents an IP address prefix with associated prefix length, supporting string conversion and comparison.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the IP address object is initialized.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the IP address to its string representation.

methods.name: InSameSubnet
methods.description: Checks if two IP addresses are in the same subnet given a subnet length.
